messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the streaming/chat postmortem — I want to lock down owners and timelines for the reconnect/partial-response work. TL;DR: recurring pattern of client timeouts + server partial responses. Need short-term mitigations and a medium-term SDK/server fix.

Priya: +1. I can own the SDK reconnect behavior changes (client side). Plan: add exponential backoff with max jitter, and a fast-path reconnect for idempotent chat flows. Target: PR by 2026-04-05.

Marco: I'll take the server-side fixes: increase keepalive frequency, return explicit "stream-abort" reason for partial sends, and add a server-triggered reconnect hint header. ETA: design doc by 2026-03-31, implementation in two sprints.

Jess: I'll track rollout and dashboards. Action items for monitoring: partial_response_rate, reconnect_attempts, median_recovery_ms, and number_of_open_streams. Will add panels to console and alert if partial_response_rate > 0.5% over 10m.

Sam: Nice. Can we also add a short-term mitigation to reduce user-facing errors? E.g., client retries for transient ECONNRESET + 499 responses, and server fallback to smaller chunk sizes.

Priya: Yes — I'll add retry for ECONNRESET + 499 up to 3 attempts with increasing delay. For chunking, Marco if the server can detect long partial frames we can force flush smaller frames.

Marco: Agreed. We'll add a server-side flag ENABLE_SMALL_CHUNKS that can be toggled at runtime for affected clusters. Ops can flip if we see a spike.

Sam: Ownership summary: Priya = SDK reconnect + client retry rules (PR 2026-04-05), Marco = server abort reasons + keepalive + togglable small-chunk flag (design 2026-03-31), Jess = dashboards + alerts (panel + runbook update by 2026-03-29). I'll own cross-team coordination and follow-ups.

Jess: Creating tracking tasks in the incident board now. I'll link JIRA IDs here when done.

DevOpsBot: New epic created: RT-4321 "Streaming reliability — reconnect and partial response remediation" by Jess.

Priya: Quick engineering note: SDK change will include a compatibility shim so existing clients don't break. Example pseudocode for reconnect logic:
```
if (stream.closed && error in [ECONNRESET, TIMEOUT, 499]) {
  for (attempt=1; attempt<=3; attempt++) {
    await sleep(backoff(attempt) + jitter());
    reconnect();
    if (reconnected) break;
  }
}
```

Marco: For the server, we'll add an explicit trailing frame for partial responses: {"status":"partial","id":"<request-id>","cursor":"<kvCursor>"} so clients can decide to reconnect vs. wait. Need API compatibility check.

Sam: Good call. Make sure to document behavior in the API changelog and release notes for both SDK and server.

Jess: Also suggesting a short-term alert runbook step: if partial_response_rate spikes, Ops should flip ENABLE_SMALL_CHUNKS and reduce max client timeout in gateway from 45s -> 30s. Documented in runbook draft.

Priya: Will add automated integration tests simulating partial frames + reconnect to prevent regressions. Test plan: simulate partial payload, simulate ECONNRESET after N tokens, assert client returns complete or successfully reconnects.

Marco: I'll schedule a sync next Tue 10:00 to review design doc and compatibility matrix.

Sam: Let's aim to close the high-priority remediation tasks in 3 weeks and medium-term on a 6-week cadence. I'll follow up in next incident review.

Jess: JIRA epic RT-4321 linked: https://jira.internal/RT-4321 (add your sub-tasks).

Priya: Done — created RT-4325 (SDK reconnect) and RT-4326 (SDK tests).

Marco: Created RT-4327 (server trailing frame) and RT-4328 (keepalive tuning).

Sam: Thanks — I'll update the postmortem with owners/timelines and mark this follow-up as "action items assigned". Reminder: add regression evals for partial-response quality checks.

Jess: Noted. I'll run a weekly check for recurring incidents and surface any patterns to incident review. (reacted with :eyes:)

Priya: One more thing — we should include guidance for customers using older SDKs: recommend upgrade and enable reconnect patch via feature flag. I'll draft a short customer note.

Sam: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, post here and I'll escalate. Closing thread for now — will reopen after the design sync. :thumbsup:
